home.statement: I build small, focused apps and games for Android — the kind that do one thing properly and stay out of your way. Everything here is designed, written and shipped solo.

listkeeper.description: Most list apps grow until they need a tutorial. ListKeeper goes the other way: a fast, clean place to keep your lists, with nothing bolted on that you'll never open. Make a list, check things off, get on with your day.

whataretheodds.tagline: Beat the odds. Climb the ladder.
whataretheodds.description: Start at 1 in 10. Guess the number and 1 in 20 unlocks. Keep going and the ladder runs all the way to 1 in 10,000 — then to Custom odds, where you pick your own impossible number. Most attempts fail. That's the game.
features: Eleven tiers from 1 in 10 to Custom odds
Attempts refill over time, even while closed

pixelwrangler.description: An arcade roguelite about wrangling cube-creatures out of a destabilised feed before it overwhelms you. Fifty waves, a deck of upgrade cards drafted as you climb, and a shard economy that carries progress between runs.
features: Shard economy and a persistent perk tree

footer.blurb: Independent developer building small, focused apps and games for Android.
